lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. David Pan is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ David is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ David Pan is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What David kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "David's gone." Axel looks at you for a long moment. "You're not David." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Lily blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Silver Tongue (Level 1). Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: David Pan, 41 days. The mantle passes to Lily Gonzalez.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Lily Gonzalez, 28 — a journalist. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Rain Dancer.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with David — and David is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Axel, Sierra, Felipe and 6 more speak for Lily — "David trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Lily before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
